```{r setup, message=FALSE, cache=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)

library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(MuMIn)
library(glmmTMB)
library(emmeans)
library(broom)
library(broom.mixed)

library(gridExtra)

library(knitr)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(comment="", cache=T, warning = F, message = F, fig.path = "images/")

options(contrasts = c("contr.sum", "contr.poly")) #needed for Type III SS

print_anova_table <- function(df, mod) {
  df %>% select(c("trait", "term", "p.value")) %>% 
    mutate(p.value=p.value %>% map_chr(~ format(.x,scientific=-2, digits=2 , nsmall=2)) %>% 
             str_replace("e-0(\\d)"," x 10^-\\1^") %>% str_replace("e-(\\d+)"," x 10^-\\1^")) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from=term, values_from=p.value) %>% 
    mutate(singular = map_lgl(mod, isSingular),
           R2m = map_dbl(mod, ~ MuMIn::r.squaredGLMM(.x)[[1,"R2m"]])) %>% 
    kable
}

load("data/maxfield_data.rda")
```

# Floral traits

```{r morphology_split}
options(contrasts = c("contr.sum", "contr.poly"))
mt.mod.split.subplot <- map(set_names(traits), 
                            ~ lmer(mnps.subplot[[.x]] ~ year * snow * water + (1|plot), data=mnps.subplot))
mt.mod.split.plant <- map(set_names(traits), 
                          ~ lmer(mnps.plantyr[[.x]]   ~ year * snow * water + (1|plot) + (1|plotid), data=mnps.plantyr))

mt.mod.split.subplot.coefs <- map_dfr(mt.mod.split.subplot, tidy, .id="trait")
mt.mod.split.plant.coefs   <- map_dfr(mt.mod.split.plant,   tidy, .id="trait")

mt.mod.split.subplot.tests <- map(mt.mod.split.subplot, anova) %>% map_dfr(tidy, .id="trait")
mt.mod.split.plant.tests   <- map(mt.mod.split.plant,   anova) %>% map_dfr(tidy, .id="trait")

print_anova_table(mt.mod.split.plant.tests, mt.mod.split.plant)

mt.emm.split.plant <- map(mt.mod.split.plant, ~ summary(emmeans(ref_grid(.x), ~ year * snow * water)))
```

```{r compare_split_models, fig.width=8, fig.height=9}
mt.mod.split.coefs <- bind_rows(subplot=mt.mod.split.subplot.coefs, plant=mt.mod.split.plant.coefs, .id="unit")

mt.mod.split.coefs %>% filter(effect=="ran_pars") %>% mutate(trait = fct_relevel(trait, traits)) %>% 
ggplot(aes(y=estimate, x=paste0(group," (",unit," means)"))) +
  facet_wrap(vars(trait), scales="free_y") + 
  labs(x="Random effect (data)", y="Standard deviation", color="Data", shape="SD < 1e-4") +
  geom_point(aes(color=unit, shape=estimate < 1e-4), size=3) + 
  geom_line(aes(group=group), color="black") + 
  scale_x_discrete(guide=guide_axis(angle=90)) + scale_y_continuous(limits=c(0,NA)) +
  theme_bw() + theme(legend.position = "top")

mt.mod.split.coefs %>% filter(effect=="fixed", term!="(Intercept)") %>% mutate(trait = fct_relevel(trait, traits)) %>% 
ggplot(aes(y=estimate, x=paste0(term," (",unit," means)"))) +
  facet_wrap(vars(trait), scales="free_y") + 
  labs(x="Fixed effect (data)", y="Estimate", color="Data") +
  geom_point(aes(color=unit), size=2) + 
  geom_line(aes(group=term), color="black") + 
  scale_x_discrete(guide=guide_axis(angle=90)) + theme_bw() + theme(legend.position = "top")

mt.mod.split.tests <- bind_rows(subplot=mt.mod.split.subplot.tests, plant=mt.mod.split.plant.tests, .id="unit")

mt.mod.split.tests %>% mutate(trait = fct_relevel(trait, traits)) %>% 
ggplot(aes(y=p.value, x=paste0(term," (",unit," means)"))) + 
  facet_wrap(vars(trait), scales="free_y") + 
  labs(x="Fixed effect (data)", y="P value", color="Data") +
  geom_point(aes(color=unit), size=2) + 
  geom_line(aes(group=term), color="black") + 
  scale_y_log10() + geom_hline(yintercept=0.05)+
  scale_x_discrete(guide=guide_axis(angle=90)) + theme_bw() + theme(legend.position = "top")
```


```{r split_model_diagnostics, fig.width=7, fig.height=10}
library(sjPlot)
library(grid)
library(gridExtra)
plot_diag <- function(models, trait) {
  diag.plots <- sjPlot::plot_model(models[[trait]], type="diag")
  traitname <- c(traitnames, leaftraitnames, phystraitnames)[[trait]]
  if(is.null(diag.plots[[2]]$round)) {
    panel <- textGrob(traitname, gp=gpar(fontsize=16)) 
  } else {
    panel <- diag.plots[[2]]$round + ggtitle("Random effect: rounds", subtitle=traitname)
  }
  grid.arrange(grobs=list(diag.plots[[4]], panel,
                     diag.plots[[2]]$plotid + ggtitle("Random effect: subplots"), 
                     diag.plots[[2]]$plot   + ggtitle("Random effect: plots"), 
                     diag.plots[[1]], diag.plots[[3]]))
}
plot_diag(mt.mod.split.plant, "corolla_length")
plot_diag(mt.mod.split.plant, "height_cm")
plot_diag(mt.mod.split.plant, "flowers_est")
```

# Physiology traits

```{r phys_split}
# lump 2019-08-15 entry with previous day
wue <- wue %>% mutate(round = as.character(date), round=recode(round, "2019-08-15"="2019-08-14"), round=factor(round))

options(contrasts = c("contr.sum", "contr.poly"))
wue.mod.split.subplot <- map(set_names(phystraits), 
                            ~ lmer(wue.subplot[[.x]] ~ year * snow * water + (1|plot), data=wue.subplot))
wue.mod.split.plant <- map(set_names(phystraits), 
                          ~ lmer(wue[[.x]]   ~ year * snow * water + (1|plot) + (1|plotid) + (1|round), data=wue))

wue.mod.split.subplot.coefs <- map_dfr(wue.mod.split.subplot, tidy, .id="trait")
wue.mod.split.plant.coefs   <- map_dfr(wue.mod.split.plant,   tidy, .id="trait")

wue.mod.split.subplot.tests <- map(wue.mod.split.subplot, anova) %>% map_dfr(tidy, .id="trait")
wue.mod.split.plant.tests   <- map(wue.mod.split.plant,   anova) %>% map_dfr(tidy, .id="trait")

print_anova_table(wue.mod.split.plant.tests, wue.mod.split.plant)

wue.emm.split.plant <- map(wue.mod.split.plant, ~ summary(emmeans(ref_grid(.x), ~ year * snow * water)))
```

# Selection: survival/flowering vs. treatments
Graphs are for random effect of plot and then subplot
```{r selection_surv}
library(glmmTMB)
options(contrasts = c("contr.sum", "contr.poly"))
wue.mod.split.surv <- glmmTMB(survived ~ year * snow * water, data=wue, family=binomial)
wue.mod.split.surv.re <- glmmTMB(survived ~ year * snow * water + (1|plot) + (1|plotid), data=wue, family=binomial)
plot_model(wue.mod.split.surv.re, type="diag")

wue.mod.split.flrd <- glmmTMB(flowered ~ year * snow * water, data=wue, family=binomial)
wue.mod.split.flrd.re <- glmmTMB(flowered ~ year * snow * water + (1|plot) + (1|plotid), data=wue, family=binomial)
plot_model(wue.mod.split.flrd.re, type="diag")
```
